name: Wellstar Kennestone Hospital VolunTeen Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. Tasks include customer service, moving patients and helping people find their way. You can work in clinical and non-clinical departments. It is one 2-hour shift a week for 6 of the 8 weeks.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 16 to 18. Picks are based on the full application. They also look at whether you can keep the time commitment. They look at past volunteering, GPA, leadership, speaking skills and interest in health careers.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. The page mentions no fees.
duration: 8-week summer session in June and July, one 2-hour shift a week for 6 of the 8 weeks
deadline_text: Application window Feb 1 to 15, forms due Feb 28. The page does not print a year, so treat this as the yearly pattern and check for 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online during the window. Email your shot record as a PDF. It needs 2 MMR, 2 Varicella or proof of the illness, and 1 Tdap. Your school counselor fills out and signs the recommendation form and emails it. The interview is in March and the orientation is in April. After you are accepted, you get TB test steps.
notes: Accepted students may keep volunteering in the school year if Volunteer Services says yes. It is competitive. This is an unpaid volunteer role, so no work permit.
